Two days ago (the 10th), the Home Affairs Department announced the "Woh Tsai Shan Optimization Plan," which will clear the illegal structures that have long been placed on Bishop's Hill in Sham Shui Po in phases. The first phase covers the area from the foothill to the summit of the hillside sitting-out area at Tong Yam Street, while the second phase covers the foothill to the summit near Berwick Street for fencing off.

At present, the second phase area still retains quite a number of fitness equipment and deity statues, with local residents on site kicking shuttlecocks, playing table tennis, and using the fitness equipment. As for the area around the Tong Yam Street hillside sitting-out area, barbed wire and hoardings were already put up last night, with security guards stationed there this morning, prohibiting residents from entering.
